title: Slimer's Universal Madness
description: The collapse of time and space has left some annomalies behind...
body:
The fabric of Minecraft’s universe is unraveling, causing a bizarre collision of times and dimensions! From aliens to parasites, this mod introduces a crazy assortment of mobs, biomes, and items that have spilled into the Overworld, Nether, and End due to a catastrophic space-time rift.

![Mod's official Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c1e07d2b231ffc275706040de0f61f8f73248887.png)

Features:

Mars Biome: Explore the harsh, red desert of Mars, where sunlight is so intense you’ll need special suits to survive.

Martians: The Martians are tiny, alien-like creatures that look like the classic "greys" from popular culture, but with a twist—they're blue! These little beings inhabit the Mars Biome and are generally peaceful unless provoked. If an intruder harms one of their kind, they retaliate with laser blasts, defending their colony with surprising ferocity.

Purplonium Ore: A rare and powerful mineral from the future, Purplonium allows you to craft high-tech laser weapons and radiation-proof armor. It’s hard to find, but worth the effort!

Walking Tree: The Walking Tree is a twisted, aggressive version of its former self. Infested by a parasitic organism, trees have become hostile creatures. Strange tentacles have grown out of the bark shell, allowing them to roam the landscape. Ears now peer out from their bark, and they attack any person that comes near their corrupted leaves. Most of them are the same, but the cactus reflects damage, flower variant spawns bees and dark oak has been dominated by Illagers

Blue Rosebush:  It may seem like just a beautiful flower, but it is a rare and mysterious plant that appears in the Overworld as a result of the space-time rift. Found in small patches in forests and plains, this rosebush is highly sought after for its unique color and calming appearance.

Cybernetic Flower: It's a product of a futuristic world where nature and technology have merged. This flower’s petals are made of Silicon rather than organic material, giving it a metallic sheen and a robotic appearance. Found in the Mars biome, these flowers are not just decorative—they are key components for crafting high-tech gear.

Retrorex: A tirannical dinosaur, straight out of a vintage paleoart book. This tyrant roams the deserts and  of Minecraft, lumbering around with its scaly, projectile proof skin. It's crushing teeths can be used to make puncturing knifes!

Junkrat: Toys made alive, from a broken world of pollution. Out of place in this launch, could they be tied to a future update?

Languages available:
English(US)
Português(BR)
